_README: STARTER PROFILE. Copy this file, rename it to <journal_id>.json, fill it in.
Files whose name starts with an underscore are ignored by the loader, so this
one never appears in the journal dropdown.
2. Set `id` to the filename stem. It must be unique.
3. Open the journal's Guide for Authors and fill in only what it states.
Delete any key you cannot verify - omitted keys fall back to the
schema defaults in retypeset/profile.py and produce no false failures.
4. Leave `verified` false until every number came from the publisher's
own page. Unverified profiles report warnings only, never failures.
5. Record the URL you read each number from in `sources`.
6. Restart the app. No code changes, no imports, no registry.
MOST JOURNALS NEED ALMOST NOTHING. Per-journal variation is overwhelmingly
just abstract length, keyword count and required sections. Inherit the rest
from the publisher's baseline by copying elsevier_generic.json / ieee_
transactions.json / springer_sn.json / mdpi.json and changing 3-4 numbers.
Delete this _README key in your copy.
journal: Full journal name as printed on the masthead
publisher: Elsevier | IEEE | Springer Nature | MDPI | Wiley | Taylor & Francis | ...
guide_url: https://... the Guide for Authors page
notes: Anything a human reviewer should know: quirks, things you could not confirm, whether the journal accepts format-free submission.

sources.structure.abstract_max_words: https://... page you read it from
sources.figures: https://... page you read it from
